speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates
speckit.author: GitHub

saas-feature.name: SaaS Feature Delivery Cycle (Delta-Global)
saas-feature.description: Delta-Global feature delivery: optional research → spec + clarify → plan (GraphQL directives, owner-scoped, global flag, Service Interaction Map) → tasks by user story → checkpointed tests-first implementation → real CI gate battery → evidence-based verify → alerts/dashboards in platform-infra → release(<app>) → staging pin → flag ON → production pin + ArgoCD sync → flag retirement and retro.
saas-feature.author: satcom

hotfix.name: Hotfix Delivery (Delta-Global)
hotfix.description: Mitigate first (flag OFF or pin back) → scope → failing regression test → minimal fix → gate battery → verify → release(<app>) → staging → production pin → monitor → blameless postmortem with owned actions.
hotfix.author: satcom

migration-only.name: DB Migration Delivery (Delta-Global)
migration-only.description: Schema-only change shaped by the api db-migrate init container (one transaction, previous release serving, no backups): expand / contract / backfill / index / constraint, check:migration-* gates, Allow-Contract-Migration trailer with evidence, pg_dumpall snapshots, migration record, api-first release.
migration-only.author: satcom

feature-research.name: Feature Research → Spec (Delta-Global)
feature-research.description: Idea → /speckit.research (grounded in the platform, then prior art, 2026 state of the art, stack-compatible options, failure modes, compliance, cost — cited) → go/park/reject gate → spec + clarify ready for saas-feature.
feature-research.author: satcom
